verses.pali: … Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye saṁvejaniyesu ṭhānesu saṁvijjanti;
verses.english: … so too the sentient beings inspired by inspiring places are few,

verses.pali: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye saṁvejaniyesu ṭhānesu na saṁvijjanti.
verses.english: while those who are uninspired are many.
